newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Land mine kills 10 in central Somalia.
newsitem.headline: Land mine kills 10 in central Somalia.

text.p: A land mine has killed 10 militiamen loyal to faction leader Hussein Aideed in central Somalia, a clan elder said by radio on Monday.
The mine blew up their vehicle on Sunday at Dhabbad village in the Galgudud region, about 650 km (400 miles) north of Mogadishu, elder Ahmed Dahir said. Thirteen were wounded.

Nine people were killed and six wounded when fighting erupted in the same village last Friday between militiamen loyal to Aideed and those loyal to an ally of Aideed's rival, Ali Mahdi Mohamed, residents said on Saturday.
Residents said that fighting broke out when some villagers, supporters of Ali Mahdi's ally General Omar Haji, turned down a request to back an Aideed government.
